title: C.H. Robinson Foundation awards $2.25 million to nonprofits creating stronger communities
summary: The C.H. Robinson Foundation is awarding $2.25 million to more than 100 nonprofits supporting economic opportunity, the supply chain and local communities.

# C.H. Robinson Foundation awards $2.25 million to nonprofits creating stronger communities


#### Annual grants support economic opportunity, the people who keep the supply chain moving and critical needs in local communities.


-
-
-
-
- Copy to clipboard


Copy to clipboard


Link Copied


November 13, 2026 | Press Release


**EDEN PRAIRIE, Minn. (November 13, 2026)** —The C.H. Robinson Foundation is awarding $2.25 million in grants to more than 100 nonprofit organizations working to create opportunities for people, strengthen the transportation and logistics industry and address critical needs in communities.


The 2026 grants build on a long history of giving. Since 2005, the Foundation has contributed more than $35 million to nonprofit organizations around the world. This year’s grants support work ranging from education and workforce development to programs that support carriers and drivers and advance environmental sustainability. In the Twin Cities, home to C.H. Robinson’s global headquarters, the Foundation also supports organizations addressing critical community needs, including hunger, shelter, education and workforce development.


Behind that work are organizations like the Next Generation in Trucking Foundation, which introduces students to careers in trucking, transportation, logistics and the supply chain through hands-on experiences, national student organizations and resources for educators and school counselors. Last year, the organization reached more than 100,000 students. With continued support from the C.H. Robinson Foundation, Next Gen Trucking will expand career awareness, curriculum and scholarships, helping more students across the United States and Canada discover and prepare for careers that keep the supply chain moving.


“When young people find something they’re good at and experience success, it changes their lives,” said Lindsey Trent, president, Next Generation in Trucking Foundation. “That's what we're seeing in schools across the country as students discover their strengths through trucking career and technical education programs. Many of these students are finding a sense of purpose and a pathway to careers where they can succeed and support a family. Support from the C.H. Robinson Foundation helps us bring these opportunities to more schools and more students.”


Another longtime partner, Bridging, empowers people to thrive in their homes by providing quality furniture and household goods for those pursuing housing stability. Bridging is volunteer-driven and relies on community donations of basic home essentials and financial contributions, including Foundation support that covers everyday costs like sorting donations and delivering furniture, to furnish homes with hope. In 2025, the nonprofit furnished homes for 5,320 households in the Twin Cities, including 5,863 children.


“Our nonprofit partners bring deep expertise and a firsthand understanding of the needs and opportunities in the communities they serve,” said Rachel Schwalbach, Vice President ESG and President of the C.H. Robinson Foundation. “We’re proud to support their work and the people behind it, helping create stronger communities, expand opportunity and build a stronger future for our industry.”


### 2026 C.H. Robinson Foundation grants span three areas:


- **Economic Opportunity Grants:** Supporting pathways to long-term economic opportunity, including postsecondary education, skills development, workforce entry, career advancement and entrepreneurship.
- **Strategic Industry Grants:** Supporting organizations helping the transportation and logistics industry thrive, including efforts related to carriers and drivers, transportation and logistics education, workforce development and environmental sustainability.
- **Twin Cities Grants:** Supporting organizations addressing community needs such as hunger, shelter, education and workforce development in our headquarters community.


C.H. Robinson keeps the world’s goods moving, and how we do it matters. Through the C.H. Robinson Foundation, that commitment comes to life by supporting nonprofit organizations creating meaningful opportunities and stronger communities. The generosity and passion of our people further that impact, helping C.H. Robinson be a force for good where we live and work.


Learn more about[the work of the C.H. Robinson Foundation](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/about-us/corporate-responsibility/community/foundation-giving/) . For the full list of grant recipients, see below.

#### About C.H. Robinson


C.H. Robinson is the global leader in Lean AI supply chains. For more than a century, companies everywhere have looked to us to reimagine how goods move. Now, as we redefine what’s next for the industry, that same drive fuels our commitment to Building Tomorrow’s Supply Chains, Today™. Trusted by 74,000 customers and 450,000 contract carriers, we manage an unmatched 37 million shipments annually, representing $23 billion in freight. We deliver tailored solutions across the world via truckload, less-than-truckload, ocean, air, and more. With our unique combination of human insight and Lean AI working as one, supply chains move faster, smarter, and more sustainably. As a responsible global citizen, we proudly contribute millions to the causes that matter most to our employees. For more information visit[www.chrobinson.com](https://www.chrobinson.com/en-us/) .
